title: Fallout 3 — MQ04 State / Session Reconstruction Semantics Audit v2.7

PlayerInTL.declaration_comment: flag set to 1 when player actually enters Tranquility Lane; set back to 0 when he exits
writers: 0004C255 MQ04PlayerContainerScript sets MQ04.PlayerInTL to 0 on physical return

DadGreet.declaration_comment: flag set when back in Vault 112; used to handle packages for Dad

DadInfo.declaration_comment: flag set to 1 when player asks about Dad's whereabouts, used to update dialogue choices

DadDogInfo.declaration_comment: flag set when player learns dad is a dog
DadDogInfo.writer_context: All three writer INFO records belong to MQ04 and condition on Betty 0002449C.

NPCReset.declaration_comment: flag used for tracking reset updates every morning
NPCReset.readers_writers: BettyScript plus resident scripts and multiple MQ04 INFO result scripts

DeadNPCs.declaration_comment: incremented when anyone in TL is killed; talking to Betty after incrementing causes her to reset things so everyone is alive
DeadNPCs.readers_writers: Multiple Tranquility Lane resident scripts increment it; BettyScript resets it to 0.

SafetyLock.declaration_comment: flag for safety protocols preventing NPCs from permanent death; 0 for no permanent death, 1 to allow permanent death

Invasion.declaration_comment: flag set when player uses failsafe terminal; triggers endstate behavior for Chinese Invasion

identity_state_result.evidence: DadInfo and DadDogInfo are explicit MQ04 script variables with primary ESM comments and INFO result-script writers.
identity_state_result.meaning: The shipped game records James-related identity/discovery state independently from the physical actor and simulation Doc role.
identity_state_result.non_implication: These scalar flags do not contain James's autobiographical memories, neural state, personality, or whole-person representation.

save_james_effect.new_validation_use: DadInfo/DadDogInfo and the MQ04Doc binding can serve as identity/provenance checks for any independently discovered James memory payload.
